تستنجدوا (form X)
# تَسْتَنْجِدُوا (tastanjidū) /tas.tan.d͡ʒi.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْجَدَ (istanjada)
# تُسْتَنْجَدُوا (tustanjadū) /tus.tan.d͡ʒa.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْجَدَ (istanjada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
